technique: The exp056 topology (expand 8 candidates, then deterministically select by corpus-coverage score in Swift) is run unchanged, but the underlying generative model is swapped from the SFT champion adapter to the orpo_op_e1 RL adapter — testing whether the best topology and a softer-preference RL base are additive.
